Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned APP for the State and the learned counsel for O.P. No. 2.
2.

The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 129 of 2024, Trial Case No. 4207/2024 registered for the offence punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and section  of Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. According to allegation, the marriage of the complainant was solemnized with the petitioner on 18.02.2022.

Thereafter, the accused persons including the petitioner tortured the complainant physically and mentally for demand of one Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.11275 of 2025(7)
dt.02-12-2025 bolero vehicle and Rs. 4 Lakhs as dowry and ousted her from the matrimonial house.
4.

The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely Harshit Singh @ Harshit Kumar Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/122676923/

sentences.text: He has submitted further that the petitioner is ready to keep the complainant with full dignity and honour.
He has also submitted that the petitioner is ready to pay Rs. 5,000/- per month as interim maintenance to complainant/opposite party no.
5. On the other hand, the learned counsel for O.P. No. 2 has opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

6. Considering the above-mentioned facts and circumstances, let the petitioner, in the event of his arrest or surrender within four weeks before the learned court below, be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M., Siwan in connection with Complaint Case No. 129 of 2024, Trial Case No. 4207/2024, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2)
Cr.P.C./482(2) of the B.N.S.S., 2023, with further condition that the petitioner shall pay Rs. 5,000/-
per month Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.11275 of 2025(7) dt.02-12-2025 as an interim maintenance to opposite party no. 2 (the complainant).
7.
This interim maintenance shall be subject to adjustment, if any other court grants maintenance to the complainant/opposite party no. 2.

(Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J) Ranjeet/-
